falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above 5,500 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout above key resistance would invalidate the 'hold' signal by confirming a bullish trend contrary to the pattern's historical bottom context

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 70+ within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Exceeding the threshold would indicate extreme pressure invalidating the 'unknown' verdict by confirming a blowoff scenario rather than a consolidation pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: The Federal Reserve announces a 50-basis point rate cut in its next policy meeting
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: An aggressive rate cut would create a clear macro catalyst contradicting the 'hold' signal and proving the pattern match analysis incomplete

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
